description: During the 2026-08-07 bookkeeping pass, scripts/gen_api_docs.py silently ran 'cargo install rustdoc-md --locked' when it found the binary missing. The CLAUDE.md bookkeeping-pass routine says to REPORT a missing tool and note it in the hand-off, not to install it -- an agent told not to install anything cannot comply if the script installs on its behalf. Add a --no-install flag, or prompt, or at minimum print a loud notice.
title: scripts/gen_api_docs.py auto-installs rustdoc-md without asking

title: docs+cleanup: finish Go-beads → beads-rs migration
